title: Technical English — Course 5, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 8

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the quality presentation take place?
tasks.audioText: The quality improvement group will present its findings on Monday at two fifteen in the conference room. Students should bring the process chart and the sample defect summary. The presentation will compare the number of reported defects before and after a process change. The group will also explain why the figures alone do not prove that the change caused the improvement.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which condition-monitoring summary is required for the risk review?
tasks.audioText: The quality improvement group will present its findings on Monday at two fifteen in the conference room. Students should bring the process chart and the sample defect summary. The presentation will compare the number of reported defects before and after a process change. The group will also explain why the figures alone do not prove that the change caused the improvement.

tasks.prompt: A workshop team introduced a revised inspection checklist after repeated recording errors. The number of incomplete records fell during the following month. The team considered this a positive result, but it also noted that staff had received additional training at the same time. The report recommended collecting more data before attributing the improvement to the checklist alone. Reading 1. What change did the workshop team introduce?
Why did the report avoid attributing the result to the checklist alone?
options: Because staff also received additional training

tasks.prompt: The number of incomplete records ___ during the following month.
Choose TWO practices that strengthen a quality-improvement review.
options: Compare data over a suitable period
Consider other changes that may affect the result

tasks.prompt: A starting measurement used for comparison is a ___.
A manager says one improvement definitely caused the result, but another change happened at the same time. What should you say?
options: The result is encouraging, but the additional training should also be considered before assigning a cause.
We can ignore the other change.
The data are not useful at all.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of quality improvement in a logical order.
options: Review other factors before drawing a conclusion
correctOrder: Review other factors before drawing a conclusion

tasks.prompt: Write 100–120 words summarising a quality-improvement project. Describe the change, the measured result and one limitation when interpreting the outcome.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: task completion and relevant content (0–2); clear organisation and logical linking (0–2); grammar and sentence structure (0–2); precise technical vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2). Minor errors are acceptable if meaning remains clear.
